Name: Fix Animal Tool Animations
Author: bcmpinc
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
When using the shears or milk pail, you're locked in place until the animation finishes. With this mod the animation no longer plays when no animal is nearby.

[size=4][b]Dependencies[/b][/size]
This mod requires the following mods to be installed:[list]
[*] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3213]StardewHack[/url]
[/list][size=4][b]Known bugs[/b][/size]
Please report bugs on [url=https://github.com/bcmpinc/StardewHack/issues]GitHub[/url].

[*] Localization support. (Not that this mod has any text though)
